'''Magikarp Journey''' (Japanese: '''コイキングの魔法でキレイになるっ!?''', ''I'll Become Beautiful with {{tt|Koiking|Magikarp}} Magic!?''), is the second bonus chapter of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey volume 5|fifth volume]] of [[Magical Pokémon Journey]].

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
[[Hazel]] and [[Coconut]] read in a magazine about a failsafe love potion -- take one whisker of {{p|Magikarp}} and seal it in a pouch, and presto! Lacking the money to order prepackaged whiskers, they journey to the bottom of the sea.
